task.title: Recover from a failed import
task.shortdesc: Diagnose a failed JSON or multipart policy import from the BPM workflow.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: Import can fail because the file is not readable, the JSON is malformed, the Firefox boundary shape is wrong, or normalized values cannot pass validation.

step.cmd: Keep the import failure message visible and identify whether the input was JSON or multipart.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Confirm that the file contains a Firefox boundary document with a top-level policies object when JSON import is used.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: If the message reports syntax, recover the malformed JSON first.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Retry import once with the corrected file and then review normalized values before saving.

info.note: Retry only from the BPM interface; do not change profile data outside the application.

result.p: The import either succeeds into a reviewable BPM profile draft or remains blocked with a preserved visible reason.

postreq.p: If the error repeats, stop the workflow and contact support with the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current page.
